BoxedWine 26R1 (tag 26R1.0)
Commit: d7d5a1421bd781a81cbdf8f222cced11a7ebd76e
License: GNU General Public License version 2
Complete corresponding source: https://github.com/danoon2/Boxedwine/tree/26R1.0
Local resize patch: BOXEDWINE-RESIZE.patch
Local Web cache and file-read trace patch: BOXEDWINE-FILE-TRACE.patch
Local per-window X11 bridge patch: BOXEDWINE-WINDOW-BRIDGE.patch
Local X11 window activation patch: BOXEDWINE-WINDOW-ACTIVATION.patch
Local X11 focus and z-order patch: BOXEDWINE-WINDOW-FOCUS.patch
Local direct keyboard input patch: BOXEDWINE-KEYBOARD-INPUT.patch
Local reproducible build-path patch: BOXEDWINE-REPRODUCIBLE-BUILD.patch
Local inherited launch-token patch: BOXEDWINE-LAUNCH-TOKEN.patch
Local shared Win32 window-controller launch patch: BOXEDWINE-WINDOW-CONTROL.patch

The local patches add a validated path-based process launcher, generic numeric
launch ownership inherited through each process environment, native outer/client
window metadata and capabilities, a native per-window RGBA frame registry,
process visibility, input activation, window commands, focus, z-order events,
and direct SDL keyboard input used by the Windows XP shell. One generic Win32
controller maps Wine X11 window IDs to HWNDs, applies commands inside Wine's
virtual desktop, and reports the actual Win32 outer/client frame metrics. The
browser reads
the latest registered frame on request. It does not receive full pixel buffers
through postMessage. Apply the patches in the order listed in SOURCES.json
before building.
Compiler: Emscripten 6.0.6
Container: docker.io/emscripten/emsdk:6.0.6@sha256:e70c319784885fc4740761e3d473dbfa5bf092c5b55b6d08f41f7b2c9248c4a4
Resource-safe build command:
make -j1 BUILD_DIR=Build/Release SHELL_FILE=shell.html EXTRA_CPP_FLAGS=
Normalize the generated JavaScript before verification:
perl -pi -e 's/[ \t]+$//' Build/Release/boxedwine.js
Before applying BOXEDWINE-FILE-TRACE.patch, normalize its upstream files to LF:
perl -pi -e 's/\r$//' include/ksystem.h source/io/fsfilenode.cpp source/io/fszipnode.h source/io/fszipopennode.cpp source/kernel/ksystem.cpp source/sdl/startupArgs.cpp source/sdl/startupArgs.h
Official release: https://github.com/danoon2/Boxedwine/releases/tag/26R1.0
Official Web runtime: https://boxedwine.org/v/26R1/wine11/st/

The shared Win32 controller source, pinned compiler container, build command,
and output hash are recorded in native/boxedwine/SOURCES.json. The runtime
archive builder adds one controller to the shared archive; applications still
launch their original executables directly.

The full boxedwine.zip archive is the verified build input. The deployed
xp-accessories.zip archive contains the shared Wine prefix and the runtime files
observed while Calculator, FreeCell, Solitaire, and Spider Solitaire start and
operate. The build replaces Wine's Light visual style at its registered path
with the user-supplied Windows XP SP3 Luna.msstyles file (SHA-256
dd8e86e5a7c19ea9fe0e34992babefe592055d68eb8659763c8300558ca5dcb4),
and selects Luna's NormalColor scheme in the Wine user registry, so original
applications use the same Luna theme as the simulated shell.
Rebuild it with:
bun tools/build-boxedwine-xp-filesystem.ts

Rebuild the application package archive after an application catalog change:
bun tools/build-boxedwine-runtime.ts

The adjacent LICENSE-BOXEDWINE.txt file contains the BoxedWine license.
